description: Election Commission - D. R. Liyanaarachchi was selected as the member of the Matale P/S - B. M. G. G. Kumarihami was selected as the member of the Ambanganga Korale P/S - Y. G. S. Thalgahagoda was selected as the member of the Yatawatta P/S
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the declaration of newly selected members to fill seats that became vacant due to party membership cessation, which falls under electoral processes and local authority election matters. The content focuses on election-related administrative procedures rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories.
